note: Reviewed by the RFC 0016 K1 agent (2026-09-28). allocation_exceptions: test fixtures under unittests/ that allocate raw memory on their device (product code can never be excepted). idle_waits: every vkDeviceWaitIdle/vkQueueWaitIdle call site keyed by path and enclosing function (Class::Method); class is teardown, mode-change, loss-recovery, port-wait-idle or test-fixture. Entries with pending true (class frame-path) are sites still on a frame path; they fail the scan until replaced. K1 replaced the frame-path waits: one-time uploads and readbacks (EndSingleTimeCommands, ReadSceneDepth, ReadWorldMeshBytes) signal the adapter's timeline and release their staging behind its value or wait for their own value; world-mesh replacement (UploadWorldMesh, ReleaseWorldMesh) releases the old buffers behind the newest submitted value; a sampler-state change writes fresh descriptor sets and retires the old ones behind the newest submitted frame; the render.backend.v1 provider (render/device/vulkan/backend_v1/) waits for timeline values.

allocation_exceptions.reason: test fixture: creates its own raw VkDevice and 4x4 sampled images to check the grouped descriptor-set layouts of vulkan_descriptor_groups against the device limit; no product code path

idle_waits.reason: MSAA sample count change (video options); runs only between frames (returns early while a frame is open) and rebuilds the multisample targets
the native surface was lost or replaced (Android surfaceDestroyed/Created); presents nothing more to the old surface before rebuilding the swapchain
back-buffer size change (SetMode/resize); old back buffers and framebuffers are destroyed
swapchain recreation (out-of-date surface, vsync or present-mode change)

a video-settings change: CMaterialSystem::OverrideConfig when mat_forceaniso changes, and RestoreShaderObjects after a device reset, replace the anisotropic samplers that every live texture set names; never called while a frame is recorded
render.device.v2 Recover: drains the lost logical device before rebuilding it (a lost device returns at once)
render.device.v2 WaitIdle, the port's explicit drain for teardown and tests; no frame path calls it
